<script>
//<![CDATA[
// Chart.plugins.register({
// beforeDraw: function(chartInstance) {
// var ctx = chartInstance.chart.ctx;
// ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,.9)";
// ctx.fillRect(0, 0, chartInstance.chart.width, chartInstance.chart.height);
// }
// });
Chart.pluginService.register({
afterDraw: function (chart, easing) {
if (chart.config.options.showPercentage || chart.config.options.showLabel) {
var self = chart.config;
var ctx = chart.chart.ctx;

ctx.font = '600 14px Open Sans';
ctx.textAlign = "center";
ctx.fillStyle = "#337ab7";
self.data.datasets.forEach(function (dataset, datasetIndex) {
var total = 0, //total values to compute fraction
labelxy = [],
offset = Math.PI / 2, //start sector from top
radius,
centerx,
centery,
lastend = 0; //prev arc's end line: starting with 0

//for (var val of dataset.data) { total += val; } fails in IE
for(index = 0; index < dataset.data.length; index++)
total+=dataset.data[index];
//TODO needs improvement
var i = 0;
var meta = dataset._meta[i];
while(!meta) {
i++;
meta = dataset._meta[i];
}
var element;
for(index = 0; index < meta.data.length; index++) {
element = meta.data[index];
radius = 0.9 * element._view.outerRadius - element._view.innerRadius;
centerx = element._model.x;
centery = element._model.y;
var thispart = dataset.data[index],
arcsector = Math.PI * (2 * thispart / total);
if (element.hasValue() && dataset.data[index] > 0) {
labelxy.push(lastend + arcsector / 2 + Math.PI + offset);
}
else {
labelxy.push(-1);
}
lastend += arcsector;
}


var lradius = radius * 3 / 4;
for (var idx in labelxy) {
if (labelxy[idx] === -1) continue;
var langle = labelxy[idx],
dx = centerx + lradius * Math.cos(langle),
dy = centery + lradius * Math.sin(langle),
//val = Math.round(dataset.data[idx] / total * 100);
val = (dataset.data[idx] / total * 100).toFixed(0);
if (chart.config.options.showPercentage)
{
if(val > 10)
ctx.fillText(val + '%', dx, dy);
}
else if( chart.config.options.showLabel)
{
if(val > 5)
ctx.fillText(chart.config.data.labels[idx] +' '+ val + '%', dx, dy);
}
}
ctx.restore();
});
}
}
});
//]]>
</script>

function getPosition(string, subString, index)
{
return string.split(subString, index).join(subString).length;
}
function replaceTokenN(string,target,index)
{
spos = getPosition(string,'\.',index);
epos = getPosition(string,'\.',index+1);
return string.substring(0, spos+1) + target + string.substring(epos);
}
document.getElementById("settingsPieChart").onclick = function(evt)
{
var activePoints = mySettingsPieChart.getElementsAtEvent(evt);
if(activePoints.length > 0)
{
var clickedElementindex = activePoints[0]["_index"];
var label = mySettingsPieChart.data.labels[clickedElementindex];//get specific label by index
//var value = mySettingsPieChart.data.datasets[0].data[clickedElementindex];//get value by index
var fpskeyidx = window.location.href.lastIndexOf("/");
var fpskey = window.location.href.substr(fpskeyidx+1);
fpskey = replaceTokenN(fpskey,label,2);
window.location.href = window.location.href.substring(0,fpskeyidx+1)+fpskey;
}
}
document.getElementById("resolutionsPieChartHisto").onclick = function(evt)
{
var activePoints = myResolutionsPieChart.getElementsAtEvent(evt);
if(activePoints.length > 0)
{
var clickedElementindex = activePoints[0]["_index"];
var label = myResolutionsPieChart.data.labels[clickedElementindex];//get specific label by index
//var value = myResolutionsPieChart.data.datasets[0].data[clickedElementindex];//get value by index
var fpskeyidx = window.location.href.lastIndexOf("/");
var fpskey = window.location.href.substr(fpskeyidx+1);
fpskey = replaceTokenN(fpskey,label,3);
window.location.href = window.location.href.substring(0,fpskeyidx+1)+fpskey;
}
}
document.getElementById("settingsPieChart").onmousemove = function(evt)
{
var activePoints = mySettingsPieChart.getElementsAtEvent(evt);

if(activePoints.length > 0)
{
$(this).css("cursor", "pointer");
}
else
$(this).css("cursor", "default");
}
document.getElementById("resolutionsPieChartHisto").onmousemove = function(evt)
{
var activePoints = myResolutionsPieChart.getElementsAtEvent(evt);

if(activePoints.length > 0)
{
$(this).css("cursor", "pointer");
}
else
$(this).css("cursor", "default");
}
</script>
